en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ayoub Bin Nuh, raising it 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When a piece is cut off from the man, so it is dead, and and when the (other) man touches it, so every (piece) what had a bone in it, so it would Obligate the washing upon the one who touches it, and if there does not happen to be abone in it, so there is no washing upon him’.
en.sarwar: 5. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Husayn from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If a man is cut in two pieces, Salah (prayer) is performed on the part in which the heart exists.’”
